decisions.reason: The XL anamnesis package remains closely tied to the firm’s established dental software and app capabilities, so its strong knowledge fit and ability to refine it through in-house development outweigh its narrower focus on larger practices.
This support service leverages the firm’s installed base, customer-service routines, and training know-how so directly that it is highly likely to remain a complementary offering.

A materials management module is well connected to existing practice workflows and software knowledge, but as a newer add-on with less visible market commitment so far it carries a somewhat higher risk than the more established support-oriented offerings.

The secure healthcare messaging service fits the firm’s regulatory, telematics, and integration expertise very well, and the KIM-related update suggests strong learning opportunities and continuing market relevance.
